sections.bio:
👋🏽 Hey, I’m Aghya

(TL;DR: If this resonates, follow. If you’re a brand or revenue leader looking to partner, DM me. LFG 🌶️)

LinkedIn quite literally gave me a life I didn’t have

I moved from India to the US as a single child
No family. No safety net!!
Just big dreams, student loans & a very supportive dad..

And somehow… IT ALL WORKED OUT!!!
Like… what the hell??

Anywayssss coming back

👉 I’ve been a seller my whole life

My first sales gig? Selling event sponsorships to brands like BMW, Lamborghini, ABIL etc for a luxury events. I only earned a % commission from what i sold. no base salary.

Later, I sold at Burberry retail. yeahh i did it haha!!
Then I sold creators to brands like Olay & Pampers while running influencer campaigns...

Different titles
Same muscle

Sales

I built my career from scratch
Cleared ~$70K in student debt
Found community
Found my voice
And eventually… found partnerships

All cz of selling, That’s when it clicked

Partnerships are just sales with leverage
Faster deals
Lower CAC
Higher trust
Bigger avg deal sizes

If a deal can close faster with partners, why wouldn’t you use them?

The moment I realized that, I doubled down

Now I talk about 

💕 B2B sales mindset 
💕 Partner sales 
💕 Formula 1
💕 Fitness 

And I pay it forward...

If you’re

💕 Building sales revenue through partnerships
💕 Leading partner sales or partner teams
💕 A brand in B2B, revenue, fitness or F1
💕 Or someone scared to hit “post” 

DM me...I got you..

📩 Brand partnerships >> [email protected]
📩 Or just DM me; I actually reply

- Xoxo
your ra-ra-ra girl 🌶️

posts.text:
Not posting on LinkedIn is probably costing you more than you think....


(Not the fluffy kind, the real $$$ kind)


You’re letting a little bit of cringe stop you...

“What will people think?”
“What if I don’t get likes?”
“What if my coworkers see it?”


I almost listened to those thoughts...

I’m glad I didn’t....

Because that one decision has led to


💕 Being featured in Times Square by Talvy
💕 Building Citrine as a B2B content strategist 
💕 Redesigning 20+ LinkedIn profiles 
💕 Attending my first private creator dinner
💕 Crossing 10,000 followers & $10,000 in creator revenue all with 1 platform
💕 Speaking opps at podcasts & conferences


None of this happened because I had the perfect strategyyyy….


It happened because I said f**k it let’s possttt!

What’s the worst that can happen!!!!!


The cringe lasts a few minutes..

The opportunities last a life timeee…


Choose wisellyyyy!!! 

Your future self will be glad you did…🌟


PS. What’s one thing you cringed… Buh you did it anyway & it changed your lifeeee!!!

Our Fav PRM now lives inside Claude 🌟



Yeah. Let that satisfyyyy you for a second


....and honestly the timing of it couldn't be better because conference season is HEREEEE 


And we all know what that means…


Walking into a hallway, 
locking eyes with a partner you haven't spoken to in 6 weeks & 
your brain just goes… 

*pfffffffff* 🤯


Anyhoo now that doesn't matter anymore because I can pull a full partner briefing from my phone in 30 secs before walking into a room and it completely changes how I show up for every single conversation

No more blanking
No more faking it
No more "let's circle back" energy

Because the partners leaders who remember everything?

They're not smarter. They're just better equipped


Go be better equipped 💪🏻

introw.io  


#ad #introwpartner

I made a  /skill  under 2 mins….



Like genuinely thought I needed to be technical!!! Pfffff

The truth is

You already have skills built

You just haven't saved them yet

That chat where you write your outreach the same way every time?
The one where you keep telling AI your tone, your style, your rules?

You've been building a skill this whole time

You just didn't call it that

So here's what you do…

- Open any chat where you're repeating yourself
- Type: "convert this into a skill". Name it.
- Then use   /(name)   to recall the skill


That's literally it

- No coding
- No prompt engineering degree
- No 47-step framework from some guy on Twitter

Just 1 sentence and suddenly your AI remembers how YOU work

I break the whole thing down in the video 👆


This is Part 2 of the #UnofficialAIDictionary
AI for those that sell, not code 🌶️


PS. At this point I have over 13 skills built and you?

I made it to a list of top 18 partnerships creators on LinkedIn???



MEEEEE???? 🥹💪🏻🌟

Thank you George Vitko for including me, this is wilddd

When I started posting about partnerships, this was NOT on the bucket list

I just found a lane I couldn't avoid

Partnerships is sales, marketing, product, everything compressed into one

And people loved talking about it just as much as I did

Being on this list alongside People I really admire and have learned everything from is an incredible feeling


We are only getting started 🔥

If you're a partner leader… you can't deny it now

AI is changing how we sell, how we enable, how we build


Let's connect and chat about how you're using AI today 👇

I got out of bed this morning to use the bathroom… and never made it back 😭



10,000 of YOUUUUU

My day is officially over...🥹🥳



3 years ago, I had no idea what I was doing 

And todayyyy HERE WE AREEEEEE


If I were to start all over again, here are the 5 things ill swear by 


1️⃣ The Engagement Sandwich 🥪

Engage post engage!

LinkedIn rewards conversations, not broadcasts

2️⃣ Make your profile impossible to misunderstand

Your Featured section should tell people exactly what to do next

👇 Download this
👇 Watch this
👇 Book a call

Every button should work

Every CTA should be obvious

3️⃣ I live by the 20 20 20 rule

DM 20 new people

Reply to 20 messages

Spend 20 minutes leaving thoughtful comments

Most of my best opportunities started with a conversation, not a post

4️⃣ Stop looking like everyone else

Your headshot is your first impression

It shouldn’t look like a passport photo

I used Remy’s AI photo generator to create mine because I wanted my profile to actually have personality 

5️⃣ Go have a life

You can’t create interesting content if you’re living a boring life 👀

Travel

Try a new hobby

Meet new people

Go outside

We don’t follow creators because they post

We follow them because they have stories worth telling



Thank you to every single person who’s read a post, left a comment, shared an idea, or believed in me along the way ❤️

10,000 is a pretty cool milestone

Now let’s go build the next 10,000 together 👀


What’s one LinkedIn habit that’s made the biggest difference for you?
